title: Quick Pro GR:ONE Review + Test Ride + Build — MY DREAM CHINESE GRAVEL BIKE!

takeaways.text: At 188 cm he rides the 58 with the bar slammed; stack is higher than his AR:ONE road bike, and the setback gravel post adds 1.5–2 cm of effective reach compared with the zero-offset AR:ONE post.

Supplied by Quick Pro USA (affiliate code). His size-58 build with Wheeltop 1×12, Kanwin alloy-spoke carbon wheels, 45 mm tires with tubes and a 130 mm road bar weighs about 8 kg without pedals and 8.3 kg with them.

On a first 55–60 km ride over fast and wet Greek gravel it felt like a race bike, with enough rear compliance and no complaints so far; 45 mm tires were sufficient for that terrain, though he still wants 50 mm clearance.

disclosure: The creator promotes a Quick Pro USA affiliate code and thanks Quick Pro USA; the video does not state whether the frame was supplied.
summary: Build and first long test ride across pavement and wet and dry gravel in southern Greece, with handling, 45 mm clearance and value discussed.
